title.narrative: This activity will contribute to achieving results for the HEALTH: QUALITY MNAH, Prevention of Mother to Child Transmission of HIV (PMTCT) AND PEDIATRIC HIV SERVICES AND PRACTICES. output

description.narrative: The Ministry of Health and its partners at national level and in targeted counties demonstrate strengthened capacities to ensure quality maternal, newborn and adolescent health care services and practices, including prevention of mother to child transmission and paediatric HIV/AIDS services. This work breakdown structure activity contributed to sublevel results - Strengthening primary health care and high-impact health interventions,Fast-track the end of HIV/AIDS,Life saving interventions,HIV treatment and care interventions,Cross sectoral - Social and behaviour change

title.narrative: UNICEF-supported interventions strengthened maternal, newborn, and adolescent health systems in priority counties. Kangaroo Mother Care reached 85.5% of preterm and low birthweight infants, close to the 86% target. Twenty counties developed frameworks for EMTCT, paediatric, and adolescent HIV services, surpassing the target of 14. A total of 2,176 healthcare workers and community HIV champions completed skills enhancement improving service quality and coverage. Two county learning hubs were established for skills-based MNH training, and four hospitals have functional sick newborn care units in Kilifi, Nairobi, West Pokot, Turkana. School health clubs promoted health awareness in 500 schools spread throughout the country, reaching approximately 47,500 adolescents.
